case_law.method: v1.1.0 case-law rebuild: authorities selected per decision point, each opinion retrieved from CourtListener and read; holding and quote taken from the opinion text; independently re-verified before release. Previous keyword-matched Justia listings were removed.

key_cases.holding: The court held that the statutory duty to investigate is triggered only by a report of abuse or neglect that has already occurred, so a parent's prediction of future harm from a proposed placement did not invoke DSHS's duty under former RCW 26.44.050.
key_cases.relevance: Supplies the case-by-case test for whether any informant's communication, including a school report, constitutes a duty-triggering report.
key_cases.quote: Generally, a report initiates the dependency process. The duty to investigate cannot be invoked until receipt of a report.

key_cases.holding: The court held that caseworkers and DSHS have only qualified, not absolute, immunity for reporting and investigating child abuse and for placing names on the central registry, and that the good-faith condition of the RCW 26.44.060 immunity is a question of fact.
key_cases.relevance: The plaintiffs were ranch employees accused of failing to report, which frames the exposure of professional reporters on both sides of the duty.
key_cases.quote: The determination of good faith under RCW 26.44.060 necessarily presents issues of fact.

key_cases.case_name: Yonker v. Department of Social & Health Services
key_cases.holding: The court held that the public duty doctrine does not shield DSHS from a negligence claim by a mother and child whose reports of possible abuse the Department declined to investigate, because they fall within the particular and circumscribed class chapter 26.44 RCW was enacted to protect, and reversed summary judgment for the State.
key_cases.relevance: Supplies the case-by-case sufficiency test that governs any informant's report, the rule Wrigley later adopts verbatim.
key_cases.quote: If there is a question whether a report is sufficient to invoke the duty to investigate, that issue will be resolved on a case-by-case basis.
